not_authorized_body: The current account lacks platform administration permissions and cannot access this page.
access_unknown_body: Account information could not be loaded. Page content is unavailable until access permissions are verified.
crash_body: Page rendering failed. Reload the page. If the issue persists, provide the error details to an administrator.
crash_updated_body: The panel version has changed. Reload the page.
not_found_body: The name in the link is invalid, or the requested page does not exist.
connection_lost: Unable to connect to Felis. The network may be unavailable or the Cloudflare Access session may have expired. The connection resumes automatically when the network recovers. If the Access session has expired, reload the page and sign in again.
config_unavailable: Panel configuration (/config.json) failed to load. Server addresses and links may be inaccurate. Reload the page to retry.
address_copy_failed: Selected — copy it from the menu
refresh_failed: Refresh failed. The last successfully retrieved status is displayed.
